item.title: Miyazaki Events 2026: Takachiho Night Kagura, Summer Fireworks & Ancient Fire Festivals
item.description: Miyazaki, on the sunny southeast coast of Kyushu, is the cradle of Japanese myth — the land where, according to legend, the gods descended and the first emperor Jinmu set out. That heritage lives on in one of Japan’s most extraordinary festivals: the all-night sacred dances of Takachiho. Beyond the myth, Miyazaki offers palm-lined coasts, the sea-cave shrine of Udo Jingu, Aoshima’s “Devil’s Washboard” rocks, and a warm climate that keeps its festival calendar busy from summer fireworks to autumn fire festivals.
